## 💡 Feature Overview
A clear and concise description of the proposed feature and what problem it solves.

## 👥 User Story
As a `[student / moderator / admin]`, I want to `[perform some action]`, so that `[benefit / outcome]`.

## 🛠️ Proposed Solution
Describe how you think this feature should be implemented, including UX flow, API endpoints, or database changes if known.

## 🎨 UI/UX Mockups or References
If applicable, include screenshots, sketches, or links to similar implementations.

## ✅ Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Requirement 1
- [ ] Requirement 2
- [ ] Tests and documentation updated
